t0: No {environment} exists yet, so nothing can be {deploy:did}.
t1: {Environments} are set up, but nothing has been {deploy:did} to them yet.
t2: Everything Launchway {deploy:did} is running as expected.
t3: An {environment} is a named place your software goes, like staging or production. A pipeline says {deploy:do} to staging; the {environment} says where that is. It takes one minute and {deploy:does} nothing.
t5: A {run} {deploy:does} to an {environment} when it reaches a deploy step. The applications and their diagnoses will appear here once a {deploy:do} {runner} has looked at one.
